offering_description.value: Ranpak supplies paper-based protective packaging to online retailers, fulfillment operators and industrial shippers. It supplies paper consumables and machines that convert the paper into packing material at customer sites. It also sells automated equipment for packing and closing shipping cartons.

primary_products.value: paper void fill; paper cushioning and wrap; thermal liners; paper converting machines; automated carton packing and sealing equipment

quotes.quote: Ranpak has made paper the foundation of our business. This renewable, recyclable, and biodegradable material can help to protect your packages, whatever your requirements. Ranpak’s packaging engineers can create solutions that meet and exceed your needs for sustainability, performance, and cost.

Our innovation team comprises the leading talent in packaging design and engineering. Together, we’re working toward a future where all packaging is sustainable, and every company is making significant positive impact for both the bottom line and the planet.

customer_segment.value: B2B: online retailers, fulfillment operators, manufacturers and packaging distributors

end_markets.value: e-commerce fulfillment; industrial manufacturing; third-party logistics; electronics; food and beverage

revenue_model.value: product sales: paper consumables and automated packaging equipment; rental or leasing: use of paper converting machines installed at customer sites

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts sourced paper into packaging consumables and builds equipment for distributors and commercial shippers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: paper protective packaging, thermal packaging and end-of-line automation

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent packaging distributors serving commercial shippers; direct sales: large fulfillment and industrial accounts buying packaging systems and automation

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: paper converting and equipment manufacturing subject to workplace safety and environmental rules

notes: It is unclear whether Ranpak sells installation and maintenance as standalone services.

gap_fill.notes: It is unclear whether Ranpak charges separately for custom packaging design and engineering.
